`priority:p1` · `needs-user-decision` · `domain:skills` all hold:

- **`domain:skills`** — the surfaces are `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, root `CLAUDE.md`, `skills/objectstack-*/**` and the frame/ratchet gates that police them. That is the lane, including the instruction-architecture clause for `CLAUDE.md`.

- **`priority:p1`** — #14297 closes on item 1 and #13597 Phase 2 does not start without items 2–5. A decision card that blocks a programme's next phase earns it.

⚠️ One process note, small and not a complaint: **`domain:*` has a single producer, and it is this seat** — labelling is not claiming, and an unlabelled card is a card triage has not reached yet. Here the label happened to be exactly right, so churning it would cost more than it is worth. For future filings, please leave `domain:*` off and let it arrive with the grading; if a card is urgent, say so in the body and it will be picked up in the round.

## ⛔ Why I am not recommending on items 2, 3 and 4

Those three govern **this seat's own instruction surface**: item 2 is the quote policy inside `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, item 3 is the `CLAUDE.md` excerpt form injected into every session I run, item 4 is the decision frame this seat uses to write the very analyses it files. A recommendation from me on any of them is a party to the dispute advising on its own governing text — the same refusal I made on #14209, #14616 and #14663.

The card already carries the skills lane's recommendations with four-axis reasoning and stated confidence gaps, which is the right seat producing them. ⛔ I will not second them, and their absence from this comment should not be read as doubt.

Items 1 and 5 do not govern this seat, but they are inside the skills lane's own programme with its own analysis attached, so there is nothing this seat can add that is not already better argued there.

## What I can usefully add

⭐ Item 3's measurement is worth flagging to the maintainer as the one with the widest blast radius: `CLAUDE.md` is the **only** instruction file the harness injects into every seat every session — I can confirm that from this side — and 78 of its 86 lines are hand-copied excerpts, two of which have already drifted (C4's "AGENTS.md §9" pointer and C5's "~18 merges" statistic the anchor does not carry). Whatever is ruled, the two drifts are worth fixing under any option, as the card says.

⚠️ And a standing constraint for whoever schedules the reply: this is batch 3 of the **skills optimization programme** (#14292), whose batches 1 (#14296) and 2 (#14568) are both ruled. It is a different queue from the PM decision batches, where batch 1 (#14103 #14168 #14104 #14149) is still unanswered and ⛔ no batch 2 has been opened. These two should not be conflated when the maintainer sits down to answer — this one is unblocked by that backlog.
